title: 🤯 A 30-Year-Old Secret Letter Found! | Slow English Story #Shorts

subtitles.en: On an autumn afternoon, Mia and Alex visit a beautiful small town.
subtitles.zh: 在一個秋日的午後，Mia 和 Alex 造訪了一座美麗的小鎮。

subtitles.en: Next to an old clock shop, they find an old green mailbox.
subtitles.zh: 在一間舊鐘錶店旁，他們發現了一個古老的綠色信箱。

subtitles.en: Stuck at the bottom of the mailbox is a letter from thirty years ago.
subtitles.zh: 信箱底部卡著一封來自三十年前的信。

subtitles.en: The envelope is yellow.
subtitles.zh: 信封是黃色的。

subtitles.en: It has no stamp, only an address.
subtitles.zh: 上面沒有郵票，只有一個地址。

subtitles.en: It says, "To the Station Master."
subtitles.zh: 上面寫著：「致站長收」。

subtitles.en: To deliver this letter, they decide to walk to the train station.
subtitles.zh: 為了投遞這封信，他們決定步行前往火車站。

subtitles.en: They pass through quiet streets.
subtitles.zh: 他們穿過寧靜的街道。

subtitles.en: Yellow leaves fall on the ground.
subtitles.zh: 黃色的落葉灑落在地上。

subtitles.en: The scenery is very beautiful.
subtitles.zh: 風景非常美麗。

subtitles.en: Finally, they arrive at the town's train station.
subtitles.zh: 最後，他們抵達了鎮上的火車站。

subtitles.en: On the platform at sunset, there is an old man with white hair.
subtitles.zh: 在日落時分的月台上，有一位白髮蒼蒼的老人。

subtitles.en: He is the station master here.
subtitles.zh: 他就是這裡的站長。

subtitles.en: Mia gently gives the old letter to the old man.
subtitles.zh: Mia 溫柔地將那封舊信交給了老人。

subtitles.en: The old man is very surprised.
subtitles.zh: 老人感到非常驚訝。

subtitles.en: He puts on his glasses.
subtitles.zh: 他戴上了眼鏡。

subtitles.en: His hands shake a little, and he slowly opens the letter.
subtitles.zh: 他的手微微顫抖，緩緩地拆開了信件。

subtitles.en: After reading the letter, the old man smiles happily, but he has tears in his eyes.
subtitles.zh: 讀完信後，老人開心地笑了，但眼中卻泛著淚光。

subtitles.en: It is a late apology from his old friend.
subtitles.zh: 這是一封來自他老友的遲來的道歉信。

subtitles.en: The wait of thirty years finally ends in this warm autumn.
subtitles.zh: 這三十年的等待，終於在這個溫暖的秋天畫下了句點。
